name: How to Repurpose Long Videos into Viral Short Clips with IncuBrix
description: Step-by-step guide to transforming podcasts, webinars, and long YouTube videos into optimized vertical shorts with AI captions and 1-click publishing.

step.name: Upload Long-Form Video or Paste Link
step.text: Upload an MP4/MOV file or paste a YouTube or Zoom link into the IncuBrix CreatorOps dashboard.

step.name: AI Hook Detection & Virality Scoring
step.text: IncuBrix scans speech patterns, visual engagement, and topic shifts to extract 5 to 10 viral clip candidates with virality scores.

step.name: Apply Dynamic Animated Captions and Smart Reframing
step.text: Select trendy subtitle templates, auto-correct filler words, and utilize 9:16 active speaker face-tracking.

step.name: Publish Directly to TikTok, Shorts, Reels & LinkedIn
step.text: Schedule or publish your rendered clips directly across all your social channels with optimized AI titles and hashtags.
